verdict.rationale: Docs show 1-Click Clusters (16-512 GPUs) and Superclusters (2,000+ GPUs) with GPUDirect RDMA at 3200 Gb/s InfiniBand, deployable self-serve with no long-term commitment and 'first-come access' pricing, plus API/cloud-init for programmatic provisioning and Slurm/MK8s for multi-node job orchestration. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of no-sales-cycle provisioning at scale (community evidence only covers single-instance billing issues, not cluster procurement experience), and no evidence on actual wait times/availability constraints for large clusters.
